rca:flags.text: 1 of 9 upcasts found in the profiler data do not match a profile in the official index.
Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (79166 scans, 75386 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.
Niskin 20 (SA-226, ~40 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle +0.0191 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.018 PSU/m.
Niskin 24 (SA-234, ~10 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle +0.0412 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.000 PSU/m.
Niskin 20 (SA-226, ~40 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle +0.0111 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.018 PSU/m.
Niskin 24 (SA-234, ~10 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle +0.0063 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.000 PSU/m.
Autosal workbook header date is 2023-10-05 but the cast is on 2023-08-16; looks like a template leftover (not changed).
